blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Despite their outstanding performance on many NLP tasks, LLMs face serious challenges related to semantic abstraction. In this study, we are interested in understanding how LLMs leverage abstract semantic knowledge in natural language inference (NLI), which requires sophisticated linguistic capabilities to interpret implicit meanings, contextual conceptual relationships, and semantic connections between words and phrases. To this end, we propose a methodological framework for constructing new semantic knowledge at a higher level of abstraction, which we define under the notions of semantic compatibility and incompatibility for NLI. In this framework, the meaning of the lexical-semantic relations between the premise and the hypothesis is reconfigured to achieve a more flexible semantic network that induces different reasoning paths in LLMs. These new pathways show a consistent pattern of responses that allows agreement on a single response. The results demonstrate that our proposal allows to discover and compensate for LLMs’ semantic knowledge gaps in NLI, achieving significant improvements in accuracy, exceeding 10% for some models, and in particular for the non-entailment class. It is essential to note that LLMs need structured knowledge and not just more data to bridge reasoning gaps. Our hybrid approach directs attention to overlooked word relationships, allowing models to synthesize missing information. We believe that the future lies not in increasing model size, but in creating a semantic scaffolding that mimics the flexibility of human thinking. Hopefully, our proposal will enable the development of more robust agents and interpretable reasoning, guiding AI toward reliable language understanding.
blocks.zh: 尽管在很多NLP任务上表现优异,LLMS面临着与语义抽象相关的严重挑战. 在这项研究中,我们有兴趣了解LLMs如何利用自然语言推论(NLI)中的抽象语义知识,这需要精密的语言能力来解释隐含的含义,上下文的概念关系,以及词和短语之间的语义联系. 为此,我们提出了一个方法框架,用以在更高层次的抽象中构建新的语义知识,我们在NLI的语义兼容性和不兼容性概念下对此加以定义. 在这个框架中,对前提与假说之间的语法-语义关系的含义进行了重新配置,以实现更灵活的语义网络,在LLMs中诱导不同的推理路径. 这些新途径表明,反应方式一致,可以就单一反应达成协议。 结果显示,我们的提案允许发现和弥补LLMs在NLI中的语义知识差距,在准确度上取得了显著提高,某些模型超过了10%,特别是非贴身类。 必须指出,有限责任管理方案需要结构化的知识,而不仅仅是更多的数据来弥补推理差距。 我们的混合方法引导人们关注被忽略的文字关系,让模型合成缺失的信息. 我们认为,未来不在于增加模型大小,而在于创造一个模仿人类思维灵活性的语义脚手架. 希望我们的提议能够培养出更强壮的代理和可解释的推理,引导AI走向可靠的语言理解.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 1.1 Large language models and Natural Language Inference
blocks.zh: 1.1 大语言模型和自然语言推论

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) have been a milestone in the history of artificial intelligence, having demonstrated their degree of capability in understanding, knowledge, reasoning and calculation [ 1 , 2 ] .
Despite an outstanding performance in many Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks, LLMs exhibit critical problems.
It has been shown, for instance, that poor knowledge or obvious factual gaps in training data have an impact on the phenomenon of hallucinations in LLMs [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] . Moreover, if the training process is contaminated with task evaluation data a mirage of competence is created, evidenced by models that memorize specific examples but fail at new tasks [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] , or reproduce
problems inherited from human data, such as social biases and annotation artifacts [ 9 ] . To compensate knowledge gaps, it has been shown that providing external knowledge graphs can improve the quality of embedded representations [ 10 ] , mitigate hallucination [ 11 ] , and helps answer fact-intensive questions better [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLMs)是人工智能史上的一个里程碑,已经证明了它们在理解,知识,推理和计算方面的能力[1,2].
尽管在许多自然语言处理(NLP)任务中表现优异,LLMs表现出了严重的问题.
例如,已经表明,在培训数据方面知识不足或明显的事实差距对法学硕士[3、4、5]中的幻觉现象产生影响。 此外,如果培训过程受到任务评估数据的污染,就会产生能力幻影,其证明是,模型能够记住具体的例子,但在新任务中失败[6、7、8],或复制
人类数据遗留的问题,如社会偏见和注释文物[9]. 为了弥补知识差距,已经表明提供外部知识图可以提高嵌入式表达的质量[10],缓解幻觉[11],并有助于更好地回答事实密集型问题[12].

blocks.en: On the other hand, even more worrying is their inability to reason in depth. The inability of these models to perform abstract reasoning has been highlighted [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . While there are hints that pre-trained language models (PLMs) recognize differences between hyponym-hypernym relationships in nouns [ 16 ] , higher-level cognitive limitations have been observed [ 17 ] . Furthermore, LLMs lack functional and formal linguistic skills [ 18 ] , and show fundamental limitations in abstract reasoning and planning [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 另一方面,更令人担忧的是,他们无法深入地说明理由。 这些模型无法进行抽象推理的情况得到了强调[13,14,15]. 虽然有暗示预训语言模型(PLMs)承认名词中hymnym-hypernym关系的差异[16],但更高层次的认知限制被观察到[17]. 此外,法学硕士缺乏实用和正式的语言技能[18],显示出抽象推理和规划的根本局限性[19]。

blocks.en: In this study, we are interested in understanding how LLMs leverage abstract semantic knowledge and to what extent this is useful to their reasoning process and linguistic skills. To assess the usefulness of abstraction we turn to Natural Language Inference (NLI), which requires sophisticated linguistic capabilities to interpret implicit meanings, contextual concept relationships, and semantic connections between words and phrases. Addressing NLI effectively is a matter of great relevance, since it is the basis for other NLP tasks with potential applications in healthcare [ 20 , 21 ] , legal domain [ 22 ] or fact checking [ 23 , 24 ] .
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们有兴趣了解LLMS如何利用抽象语义知识,以及这对他们的推理过程和语言技能有多大用处. 为了评估抽象的用处,我们转向自然语言推论(NLI),这需要复杂的语言能力来解释隐含的含义,上下文的概念关系,以及词语和短语之间的语义联系. 有效解决NLI是一个非常重要的问题,因为它是其他NLP任务的基础,这些任务有可能在卫生保健[20,21],法律领域[22]或事实检查[23,24]中应用.

blocks.en: NLI examines whether a Hypothesis ( H H ) can be inferred from a given Premise ( P P ) [ 25 ] . The problem is to decide whether to assign an Entailment label when P → H P\to H can be evaluated to t ​ r ​ u ​ e true , a Contradiction label when P → H P\to H is considered f ​ a ​ l ​ s ​ e false , or a Neutral tag when P → H P\to H is u ​ n ​ d ​ e ​ t ​ e ​ r ​ m ​ i ​ n ​ e ​ d undetermined . Alternatively, the recognition of textual entailment (RTE) task considers two target classes: Entailment and Not-entailment .
blocks.zh: NLI审查是否可以从给定的Premise(PP)[25]推断出一种假说(H H). 问题在于决定当P → H P\to H可以被评价为 t r u e true 时,是指定一个尾贴标签;当P → H P\to H被认为是 f l s e 假贴标签时,是指定一个反贴标签;当P → H\to H是 u n d e e e r i e 未确定时,是指定一个中立标记. 另外,承认文字要求的任务考虑两个目标类别: 贴身和不贴身。

blocks.en:
LLMs can effectively address NLI when trained on benchmark datasets [ 26 ] , but stumble in scenarios that require abstract thinking, revealing a worrying dependence on superficial shortcuts that becomes evident in cognitive robustness tests [ 27 , 28 ] .
Moreover, LLMs show poor cognitive flexibility, as they do not capture the nuances of human disagreement [ 29 , 30 ] and show sensitivity to domain shift [ 31 ] . This has also been underscored by [ 32 ] , who shows that the conceptual networks of LLMs are less interconnected and less flexible than those of humans, which manifests itself in more sequential reasoning, difficulty in jumping between distant semantic domains, and limitations in analogical reasoning. This cognitive rigidity suggests a fundamentally different structure of semantic relationships than in humans and points to the need to develop models with dynamic semantic networks to achieve advanced reasoning.
blocks.zh:
LLMS在接受基准数据集培训时可以有效解决NLI问题[26],但在需要抽象思考的情景中却意外的发现,揭示了一种令人担忧的对表面快捷方式的依赖,在认知强性测试中变得很明显[27,28].
此外,LLMS在认知上的灵活性差,因为它们没有抓住人类分歧的细微差别[29,30],并表现出对域转移的敏感性[31]. 这一点也得到了[32]的强调,他们表明LLMs的概念网络比人类的概念网络互联性更弱,灵活性也更弱,这表现在更连续的推理,在遥远的语义域之间跳跃的困难,以及模拟推理的局限性. 这种认知刚性暗示了语义关系与人类有着根本不同的结构,并指出需要开发具有动态语义网络的模型来实现先进的推理.

blocks.en: 1.2 Problem statement and contribution
blocks.zh: 1.2 问题说明和贡献

blocks.en:
The previous analysis elucidates the broad limitations
and gaps in LLMs’ reasoning capabilities and semantic understanding for NLI tasks: LLMs struggle with abstract reasoning, relying on superficial cues and rigid, domain-limited conceptual networks that hinder cognitive flexibility .
blocks.zh:
前述分析阐明了广泛的局限性
以及法学硕士的推理能力和对NLI任务的语义理解方面的空白: LLMS与抽象推理斗争, 依靠肤浅的提示和刚性,

blocks.en:
We propose a methodological framework for abstracting semantic knowledge in a hierarchical way that helps to identify and fill knowledge gaps of LLMs regarding NLI. The key of our proposal is to model cognitive aspects that are implicit in NLP [ 33 ] . We propose that in NLI the meaning of the Hypothesis should be contained in the Premise, but the semantic content of H is usually more general than that of P when the entailment relation is true . This can be justified by observing that humans can identify semantic relationships at different levels of abstraction that allow us to make entailment decisions.
Consider the following example, where the problem is to decide whether P → H ​ 1 P\to H1 , or P → H ​ 2 P\to H2 is true —for clarity, we present the idea in the context of RTE: P: “A dog jumping with a ball in its mouth". H1: “An animal with a ball". H2: “A cat with a ball". In our approach, it is not just a matter of finding contextual similarities, but to know the multiple semantic relations that contribute to the decision of the fact that P P entails H H .
In this case, the use of external resources of knowledge such as ConceptNet [ 34 ] is of great help.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了一个方法框架,以分级方式抽象语义知识,帮助确定和填补法学硕士课程在NLI方面的知识空白。 我们建议的关键是模拟NLP[33]中隐含的认知方面. 我们提议,在NLI中,假说的含义应该包含在Premise中,但H的语义内容通常比P的泛泛,当必然关系属实时. 这可以通过观察人类可以识别不同抽象层次的语义关系来证明,这些抽象层次使我们能够做出必然的决定.
请考虑以下的例子,其中问题在于决定P → H 1 P\to H1,还是 P → H 2 P\to H2 是否属实——为了明确起见,我们在RTE的语境中提出这个想法:P:"一只狗在嘴里跳着球". H1:"有球的动物". H2:"一只带球的猫". 在我们的方法中,这不仅仅是一个寻找背景相似性的问题,而是一个了解多重语义关系的问题,这些关系有助于决定PP涉及H.H.
在这种情况下,使用外部知识资源,如ConceptNet[34],大有帮助。

blocks.en: “A dog jumping with a ball in its mouth".
blocks.zh: "一只狗在嘴里跳着球"

blocks.en: “An animal with a ball".
blocks.zh: “有球的动物”。

blocks.en: “A cat with a ball".
blocks.zh: “一只带球的猫”。

blocks.en: A trivial approach would be to navigate the network of ConceptNet so as to find out if there is a connection between two concepts; for example, “dog is a type of mammal" and “mammal is a type of animal" are actual pathways in ConceptNet. Eventually, we could establish a link between “dog" and “animal", but we could also establish a link between “dog" and “cat" using the same navigation scheme.
blocks.zh: 一个无关紧要的方法是引导概念网络 网以了解两个概念之间是否有联系;例如,“狗是哺乳动物的一种类型”和“哺乳动物是动物的一种类型”是概念网中的实际路径。 最终,我们可以在“狗”和“动物”之间建立联系,但我们也可以使用同样的导航办法在“狗”和“猫”之间建立联系。

blocks.en:
However, under this approach there is no notion of hierarchy between concepts: the navigation does not allow us to know whether “dog" is more general than “cat" or whether they are at the same level ; we cannot establish semantic links of another level of abstraction. Take another example, “Stockholm is part of Sweden" and “Sweden is a type of Europe" are also pathways in ConceptNet that allow to build the direct relation “Stockholm is part of Europe", similar to the is a relation.
The semantic similarity between “is part of", “is a type of" and “is a" allows to abstract a notion of generality : “animal" is more general than “dog", “Europe" is more general than “Stockholm", but “dog" is not more general than “cat" because there is another relation between them that is “distinct from".
blocks.zh:
然而,根据这种方法,概念之间没有等级概念:导航不允许我们知道“狗”是否比“猫”更普遍,或它们是否处于同一水平;我们不能建立另一层次抽象的语义联系。 举个例子,“斯德哥尔摩是瑞典的一部分”和“瑞典是欧洲的一个类型”也是概念网中允许建立直接关系的路径,“斯德哥尔摩是欧洲的一部分”,类似于关系。
“是一部分”、“是一类”和“是一类”的语义相似,因此可以抽象出一个概括性的概念:“动物”比“狗”更为笼统,“欧洲”比“斯托克霍尔姆”更为笼统,但“狗”比“猫”更为笼统,因为两者之间还有一种“区别”的关系。

blocks.en: This notion of generality is what we exploit to establish links between P and H. Thus, this abstraction of generality must exist in only one direction from P to H to infer that entailment is true. Back to our example above, P → H ​ 1 P\to H1 is t ​ r ​ u ​ e true and P → H ​ 2 P\to H2 is f ​ a ​ l ​ s ​ e false . In the first case, we know the relationship “dog is an animal" and the asymmetric relationship between “dog" (hyponym) and “animal" (hyperonym) hold —hyperonymy conveys the notion of a more general concept. But, in the case P → H ​ 2 P\to H2 , the relationship “dog is distinct from cat" and the co-hyponym relationship between “dog" and “cat" also hold —co-hyponym conveys the notion that two concepts share the same hyperonym. The former relations directly support entailment, whereas the latter do not.
blocks.zh: 这种概括性的概念是我们用来在P和H之间建立联系的。 因此,这种概括性抽象必须只存在于从P到H的一个方向上,从而推断这种含义是真实的。 回到上面我们的例子,P~H 1 P\to H1是tr ue e true和P~ H2 P\to H2是f a l s e false 。 。 在第一种情况下,我们知道“狗是一种动物”的关系,以及“狗”(hyponym)和“动物”(hypernym)之间的不对称关系——hyperymy传达了一个更普遍的概念。 但是,在P → H 2 P\to H2 案中,"狗与猫不同"的关系,"狗"与"猫"之间的共韵关系也持有——共韵传递了两个概念具有相同超词的概念. 前一种关系需要直接支持,而后一种关系则不需要。

blocks.en:
We argue that it is not necessary to know the details (definition) of a specific type of relationship, but rather that it is sufficient to abstract these relationships into categories that entail semantic compatibility.
Our hypothesis is that either LLMs do not know which relation is useful, or they ignore how to abstract them into semantically compatible categories allowing it to decide for a particular class of entailment.
blocks.zh:
我们争辩说,没有必要知道某类特定关系的细节(定义),而只需将这些关系抽象为包含语义兼容性的类别即可.
我们的假设是,要么LLMs不知道哪一种关系是有用的,要么他们忽略了如何将它们抽象成能够让它决定某一类内涵的类似类别。

blocks.en:
We propose a new methodological framework of abstraction of semantic relations that allows to improve the reasoning process of an LLM and to know to what extent these abstractions are useful in NLI.
In this way, we not only inject new knowledge to the model but also provide new semantic connections between concepts, making the conceptual network of the model more flexible. Our contribution is as follows:
blocks.zh:
我们提出了一个抽象语义关系的新的方法框架,可以改进LLM的推理过程,并了解这些抽象在NLI中有多大的用处.
这样,我们不仅为模型注入新的知识,而且还在概念之间提供新的语义联系,使模型的概念网络更加灵活. 我们的贡献如下:

blocks.en: 1. We propose a methodological framework to discover and compensate for semantic knowledge gaps of LLMs in NLI. 2. The method considers the directionality required in entailment evaluation to define abstract classes of semantic compatibility and incompatibility that guide the LLMs’ reasoning process, revealing inconsistencies in responses and weaknesses. 3. The framework provides flexibility to the reasoning and decision pipeline in that semantic compatibility and incompatibility relations allow for new valid connections between concepts, distinct inference paths and the implementation of robust decision strategies. 4. The results show that the framework is particularly useful for improving not_entailment inference and suggest that it could also contribute to develop more robust and reliable agents in the field of NLU.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 我们提出了一个方法框架,以发现和弥补在NLI中法学硕士的语义知识差距。 2. 该方法考虑必然性评价所需的方向性,以界定指导LLMs推理过程的语义兼容性和不兼容性等抽象类别,揭示反应不一致和弱点。 3. 该框架为推理和决策程序提供了灵活性,因为语义兼容性和不相容性关系允许概念之间新的有效联系、不同的推论途径和执行强有力的决策战略。 4. 结果表明,该框架对改进不匹配推论特别有用,并表明该框架还有助于在净LU领域发展更有力和更可靠的代理人。

blocks.en: We propose a methodological framework to discover and compensate for semantic knowledge gaps of LLMs in NLI.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个方法框架,以发现和弥补在NLI中法学硕士的语义知识差距。

blocks.en: The method considers the directionality required in entailment evaluation to define abstract classes of semantic compatibility and incompatibility that guide the LLMs’ reasoning process, revealing inconsistencies in responses and weaknesses.
blocks.zh: 该方法考虑了引入性评价所需的方向性,以界定指导LLMs推理过程的语义兼容性和不兼容性的抽象类别,揭示了反应和弱点中的不一致之处。

blocks.en: The framework provides flexibility to the reasoning and decision pipeline in that semantic compatibility and incompatibility relations allow for new valid connections between concepts, distinct inference paths and the implementation of robust decision strategies.
blocks.zh: 该框架为推理和决策程序提供了灵活性,因为语义上的兼容性和不相容性关系允许在概念、不同的推论途径和执行强有力的决策战略之间建立新的有效联系。

blocks.en: The results show that the framework is particularly useful for improving not_entailment inference and suggest that it could also contribute to develop more robust and reliable agents in the field of NLU.
blocks.zh: 结果表明,这一框架对于改进不匹配推论特别有用,并表明它也可以促进在NLU领域发展更有力和更可靠的代理人。

blocks.en: The remainder of the paper is structured as follows: Section 2 discusses the related work; Section 3 introduces the detailed methodological framework; Section 4 presents the experimental setup and results; Section 5 discusses the implications of the findings and limitations of the work; and Section 6 concludes with key contributions and final thoughts.

blocks.en: 2 Related work.
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作。

blocks.en:
While humans can combine simple concepts to solve complex problems or generate novel solutions, the performance of artificial neural models, such as PLMs and LLMs, deteriorates rapidly when faced with tasks that require abstraction.
Despite advances in versatile generation and reasoning, these models lack deep understanding of abstract concepts and exhibit systematic failures in semantic organization [ 17 ] , generalization of dimensions [ 35 ] and the identification of abstract semantics and semantic relations [ 36 , 37 , 38 ] .
For instance, the authors in [ 39 ] analyze the dependence of their ability to critically handle abstract concepts.
Their results suggest that abstract thinking does not arise spontaneously, and that LLMs lack consistency in their inferential processes. Another example is [ 19 ] ,
who show that these models often arrive at correct answers based on superficial patterns without understanding the underlying principles.
blocks.zh:
虽然人类可以结合简单的概念来解决复杂的问题或产生新的解决方案,但人工神经模型如PLMs和LLMS的性能在面临需要抽象的任务时会迅速恶化.
尽管在多功能生成和推理方面取得了进展,但这些模型缺乏对抽象概念的深刻理解,在语义组织上表现出系统性的失败[17],对维度的概括[35]以及抽象语义和语义关系的识别[36,37,38].
例如,[39]中的作者分析了他们关键处理抽象概念的能力的依赖性。
其结果表明抽象思维并非自发产生,而LLMs在其推论过程中缺乏一致性. 另一个例子是[19],
他们表明这些模型往往基于肤浅的规律得出正确的答案,而不理解根本原则.

blocks.en:
This limitation
may be related to an inability to maintain stable symbolic representations across varying contexts [ 40 ] . Interestingly, studies on attention maps in BERT reveal that PLMs can learn abstract relationships (such as hypernymy), but only implicitly and in a way that is biased by lexical distribution [ 16 ] . This creates a problem: while these models capture certain hierarchical structures, they do not use them as flexibly or consistently as humans do.
blocks.zh:
这一限制
可能与无法在不同情况下保持稳定的象征性表述有关[40]。 有趣的是,对BERT中关注图的研究揭示,PLM可以学习抽象的关系(如超音速),但只能以含蓄和偏颇的方式被词汇分布[16]. 这就造成了一个问题:虽然这些模型捕捉到某些等级结构,但它们并没有像人类那样灵活或一致地使用它们.

blocks.en:
The observed limitations demonstrate models’ current inability to fully capture the nuanced reasoning, abstraction and linguistic sophistication required in NLI tasks.
To effectively tackle NLI, we can find work that seeks to provide new semantic information, either through new lexical-syntactic structures or through external resources. Thus, [ 41 ] introduce virtual links between premises and hypotheses in order to overcome limitations based on lexical heuristics by extending syntactic structures, so that the model focuses on deeper contextual understanding.
On the other hand, another common strategy is to incorporate structured external resources that provide ontological and semantic information to mitigate hallucinations in their responses [ 42 ] . External knowledge improves the performance of textual entailment through various approaches: knowledge graph-text fusion [ 43 , 44 ] , dynamic semantic integration [ 45 ] , and adapter-based knowledge incorporation [ 46 ] .
blocks.zh:
观察到的局限性表明,模型目前无法充分掌握NLI任务所需的细微推理、抽象和语言精密度。
为了有效处理NLI问题,我们可以找到通过新的词汇-合成结构或通过外部资源提供新的语义信息的工作。 因此,[41]引入了场馆与假说之间的虚拟联系,以便通过扩展合成结构来克服基于词典heuristic的局限性,从而使模型侧重于更深入的背景理解.
另一方面,另一个共同战略是纳入结构化的外部资源,提供本体学和语义信息,以减少其反应中的幻觉[42]. 外部知识通过各种方法改进了文字内涵的性能:知识图文组合[43,44],动态语义集成[45],以及基于适配器的知识纳入[46].

blocks.en: In order to cover the greatest number of semantic relationships, various knowledge bases can be used, which means dealing with a wide variety of representation approaches. The heterogeneity of available knowledge resources has led [ 47 ] to develop a unified dimensional framework for relationship classification. However, this presents fundamental challenges, particularly in ambiguous dimensional mapping, where relationships often transcend single categories and the optimal dimension for a task may not be the most useful. This complexity highlights the urgency of developing innovative methods that requires a delicate balance between semantic flexibility and structural precision to address abstract reasoning problems.
blocks.zh: 为了涵盖数量最多的语义关系,可以使用各种知识库,这意味着处理各种各样的代表方式. 现有知识资源的异质性导致[47]为关系分类制定了统一的维度框架. 然而,这提出了根本性的挑战,特别是在模糊的维度绘图方面,在维度绘图中,关系往往超越单一类别,而一项任务的最佳层面可能不是最有用的。 这种复杂性凸显出制定创新方法的紧迫性,这种方法需要在语义灵活性和结构精确性之间保持微妙的平衡,以解决抽象推理问题.

blocks.en: All this suggest that the challenge lies not only in scale, but also in cognitive architecture. While the current approach of predicting tokens allows some abstraction to emerge, it seems inadequate for replicating the compositional and abstractive mechanisms of human thought. The true test will be whether they can transcend statistical imitation and achieve a genuine structural understanding. Even with advanced methods such as Abstraction-of-Thought (AoT) [ 48 ] , which forces hierarchical reasoning (from the abstract to the concrete), LLMs still demonstrate limitations in tasks requiring deep generalization, as they have an interpretative rigidity [ 49 ] and a cognitive bias [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 所有这些表明,挑战不仅在于规模,也在于认知架构。 虽然目前的预言符的方法允许出现一些抽象,但似乎不足以复制人类思想的构成和抽象机制. 真正的考验是它们是否能够超越统计模仿,实现真正的结构理解. 即使采用先进的方法,如“抽象思考”(AoT)[48],这迫使等级推理(从抽象到具体),法学硕士仍然在需要深入概括的任务中表现出局限性,因为它们具有解释性僵化性[49]和认知偏见[50]。

blocks.en: Therefore, we provide a methodological framework for abstracting semantic relationships between the premise and the hypothesis to a higher semantic level, so that models can grasp the missing generalities to effectively tackle the NLI task.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们提供一个方法框架,将前提和假设之间的语义关系抽象到更高的语义水平,以便模型能够抓住缺失的泛义,有效完成NLI任务.

blocks.en:
Our proposal not only identifies current limitations but also establishes conceptual bridges between available explicit knowledge and the implicit reasoning processes underlying the LLMs’ linguistic understanding.
We propose a categorical abstraction framework through the structured extraction of semantic relations from ConceptNet to build semantic abstraction groups that are used to prompt models. Our approach goes beyond the mere retrieval of semantic relations; its goal is to build new semantic knowledge at a higher level of abstraction, where the meaning of relations is given by their task-oriented association.
We seek to make this new knowledge work to induce reasoning paths in LLMs, different from those they would follow without this new knowledge, in a direction consistent with the classes of NLI tasks. Thus, we investigate how our categorization allows us to discover and compensate for semantic knowledge gaps in LLMs in NLI.
blocks.zh:
我们的提案不仅确定了目前的局限性,而且还确立了现有明确知识与LLMs语言理解背后隐含的推理过程之间的概念桥梁。
我们提出一个绝对抽象框架,通过从ConceptNet系统提取语义关系,来构建用于促进模型的语义抽象组. 我们的方法超越了单纯的语义关系的检索;它的目标是在更高的抽象水平上建立新的语义知识,其中关系的意义是由它们以任务为导向的联系赋予的.
我们力求使这种新的知识发挥作用,以诱导法学硕士的推理途径,不同于在没有这种新知识的情况下将遵循的推理途径,朝着与NLI任务类别一致的方向发展。 因此,我们调查了我们的分类如何使我们能够发现和弥补在NLI中法学硕士的语义知识差距。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: Inspired by the way humans solve NLI tasks, we have developed a framework that incorporates key cognitive processes, such as meaning abstraction, semantic interpretation, and inference.
blocks.zh: 受人类解决NLI任务的方式的启发,我们开发了一个包含关键认知过程的框架,如意义抽象,语义解释,和推论.

blocks.en: The framework is summarized in Figure 1 . We start by defining two abstract categories: Semantic Compatibility and Semantic Incompatibility . The abstraction step involves the analysis of the dependency tree of P P and H H to identify entities—nouns and verbs—and their corresponding attributes—modifiers such as adjectives and adverbs. We use ConceptNet to identify the semantic relationships between these entities and group them according to the definition of the abstract categories. These groups of semantic relations constitute the formal mechanism used to prompt the LLMs. From LLMs’ answers it is possible to analyze the reasoning paths and eventually propose a decision model.
blocks.zh: 图1概述了该框架。 我们首先定义两个抽象类别:语义兼容性和语义不兼容性。 抽象步骤涉及分析PP和H的依赖树,以识别实体——名词和动词——及其相应的属性——修饰词和副词等. 我们使用ConceptNet来确定这些实体之间的语义关系,并按照抽象类别的定义将其分组. 这些语义关系组构成了促进法学硕士的正式机制。 从LLMS的答案中可以分析推理途径并最终提出一个决定模式.

blocks.en: Definition 3.1: Semantic Compatibility We say that c 2 c_{2} has a relation of Semantic Compatibility with c 1 c_{1} if there is a relation from c 1 c_{1} to c 2 c_{2} and c 2 c_{2} is at a higher level in the hierarchy of the conceptual network ( generalization ) or c 2 c_{2} is at the same level with an equivalent meaning ( equivalence ). We write c 1 ​ ↑ ​ c 2 c_{1}\underset{}{\uparrow}c_{2} for the generalization relation and c 1 ​ ≡ ​ c 2 c_{1}\underset{}{\equiv}c_{2} for the equivalence relation.
Definition 3.1: Semantic Compatibility

blocks.en: Semantic compatibility helps to preserve meaning. For example, if we ask whether “person" has a relation of semantic compatibility with “man", or if m ​ a ​ n ​ ↑ ​ p ​ e ​ r ​ s ​ o ​ n man\underset{}{\uparrow}person holds, the answer is yes, since “person" is hyperonym of “man"—“person" is at a higher level in the hierarchy of the conceptual network; it generalizes “man". Thus, the semantic compatibility relationship operates under a strict directional constraint. The inverse relation p ​ e ​ r ​ s ​ o ​ n ​ ↑ ​ m ​ a ​ n person\underset{}{\uparrow}man fails to preserve the meaning, since “person” could refer to a “woman". This is an example of semantic incompatibility that we define below.

blocks.en: Semantic incompatibility helps to identify relations that either concretize concepts or create a direct contrast (or difference in meaning) between concepts. On the one hand, recalling the example above, “person" is concretized in “man", i.e. the relation p ​ e ​ r ​ s ​ o ​ n ​ ↓ ​ m ​ a ​ n person\underset{}{\downarrow}man holds. On the other hand, the most obvious cases of opposition are antonyms, but also more subtle differences in meaning are derived from co-hyponymy where terms share a hyperonym but are mutually exclusive. For example “running" and “walking" are co-hyponyms under their shared hyperonym “movement". Thus, we say that “running" has a relation of semantic incompatibility with “walking"; i.e. r ​ u ​ n ​ n ​ i ​ n ​ g ​ ≁ ​ w ​ a ​ l ​ k ​ i ​ n ​ g running\underset{}{\nsim}walking holds.
blocks.zh: 语义不相容有助于识别要么将概念具体化,要么在概念之间形成直接对比(或意义上的差异)的关系. 一方面,回顾上面的例子,“人”在“人”中被具体化,即关系p e r s o n ↓ m a n person\underset{}{\downarrow}man holds。 另一方面,最明显的反对案例是同义词,但含义上更微妙的区别也来源于同义词,其中术语共享一个超义词,但相互排斥. 例如,“运行”和“行走”是它们共同的超词“运动”下的共同韵律。 因此,我们说,“运行”与“行走”有语义不相容的关系;即r u n i g ≁ w a l k i n runng\underset {}{\nsim}行走的持有。

blocks.en: Notice that the Semantic Compatibility relation is reflexive, symmetric for c 1 ​ ≡ ​ c 2 c_{1}\underset{}{\equiv}c_{2} , and antisymmetric and transitive for c 1 ​ ↑ ​ c 2 c_{1}\underset{}{\uparrow}c_{2} . These properties can be observed in different types of semantic relations in conceptual networks. Reflexivity occurs when a concept is related to itself, while asymmetry appears in generalization or concretization relations. On the other hand, transitivity in generalization relations is bottom-up, enabling hierarchical inferences: if “dog" is a “mammal" and “mammal" is an “animal", then “dog" is an “animal" that preserve meaning according to the direction of the relation.
blocks.zh: 注意语义兼容关系具有反射性,对称性为c 1 c 2_{c_{1}\nderset{}{\equiv}c_{2}反对称性和中转性为c 1↑c_{c_{1_{nderset{}{\uprow}c_{2}. 这些属性可以在概念网络中不同类型的语义关系中观察到. 当一个概念与自身相关时,就会发生弹性,而不对称则出现在泛化或具体化关系中. 另一方面,泛化关系中的过渡性是自下而上的,可以进行等级推论:如果"狗"是"哺乳动物","哺乳动物"是"动物",那么"狗"是"动物",根据关系的方向保留意义.

blocks.en: Notice also that the Semantic Incompatibility relation is symmetric for c 1 ​ ≁ ​ c 2 c_{1}\underset{}{\nsim}c_{2} and transitive for the concreteness relationship ( c 1 ​ ↓ ​ c 2 c_{1}\underset{}{\downarrow}c_{2} ). However, unlike the generalization relation, which is also transitive, the direction of concreteness relation is top-down and does not preserve meaning. Thus, these properties organize the conceptual network, facilitating attribute inheritance and logical reasoning within the conceptual structure.

These conceptual abstractions are crucial for semantic analysis, particularly when evaluating entailment. Our framework uses ConceptNet’s predefined relationships. Hence, it is possible to identify the type, direction and interaction of connections between lexical units and sub-phrases. In the conceptual hierarchy, upward vertical links allow the establishment of logical entailment. These can be combined with horizontal links representing equivalence relations (synonyms) belonging to semantic compatibility. Horizontal links of opposite relationships (antonyms and co-hyponyms), and downward vertical links belong to semantic incompatibility rather indicating not_entailment. blocks.en: 3.3 Flexible conceptual networks: creating new connections between concepts
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 灵活的概念网络:在概念之间建立新的联系

blocks.en:
Previous groups define lists of nodes—relationships—or subgraphs connecting directly entities of P P and H H .
Since we are going to navigate in a knowledge graph, we may or may not find direct relationships between concepts. In the first case, the relationship is established in a trivial way and can be readily categorized using the defined rules. If not found, the proposal is to try to establish a link between entities of P and H by identifying possible intersections between their subgraphs, enabling precise and consistent Semantic Compatibility scope. Figure 3 illustrates this purpose using the example given in the Introduction about “Stockholm".

blocks.en: In order to enrich the groups with non-direct semantic relations between entities of P and H, we propose to follow the guidelines of the Semantic Compatibility (SC) and Incompatibility (SI) rules using the transitivity property. That is, we want to know if there are other concepts having SC relations with entities of H that in turn connect with entities of P under this same principle.
blocks.zh: 为了丰富这些团体在P和H两个实体之间的非直接语义关系,我们建议使用过渡性属性遵循语义兼容(SC)和不兼容(SI)规则的准则. 也就是说,我们想知道是否有其他概念与H实体有SC关系,而H实体又根据这一原则与P实体有联系。

blocks.en: For this, we need to develop the subgraphs of each entity of P and of H following the defined rules to find out if there are transitive connections that preserve SC or SI. The development of the subgraphs involves finding new concepts under the SC principles. These new concepts define sets of relations, or bags of relations, for each of the entities of P and H, as illustrated in Figure 4(a) .
blocks.zh: 为此,我们需要按照定义的规则开发P和H两个实体的子图,以发现是否有保存SC或SI的过渡连接. 子图的开发涉及在SC原则下找到新的概念. 如图4(a)所示,这些新概念界定了各个P和H实体的整套关系或一揽子关系。

blocks.en: The idea is to check whether there are relationships connecting these entities through the transitivity property of general and concrete relationships, and the rules of equivalence and opposition that preserve SC and SI. In fact, there are four sets among which it is possible to search for intersections. If there is any intersection between these sets, it means that there are concepts that link entities from P and H, as illustrated in Figure 4(b) .
blocks.zh: 其想法是检查是否存在通过一般和具体关系的过渡性属性以及维护SC和SI的等同和反对规则将这些实体联系起来的关系. 事实上,有四套,其中可以寻找交叉点. 如图4(b)所示,如果这些组合之间有任何交叉,则意味着有些概念将P和H的实体联系起来。

Thus, new valid connections arise from these intersections with which it is possible to enrich the groups following their definition.

blocks.en: These intersections reveal deeper connections that inform our classification of entailment, allowing us to identify direct and indirect semantic relationships that might not be immediately apparent from ConceptNet alone and that might not be present in the LLM’s conceptual network (Figure 5 ).
blocks.zh: 这些交叉点揭示了更深层的联系,这些联系为我们对必然因素的分类提供了依据,使我们能够确定直接的和间接的语义关系,而这种关系可能并不直接从概念网中看出来,也可能没有出现在LLM的概念网络中(图5)。

blocks.en: Thus, the proposed groups define sets of semantic relationships that are abstracted into the concepts of SC and SI. We will refer to these groups as abstract groups, in the sense that they do not literally define the semantic relationships involved (e.g., we do not provide explicit information about what hyperonymy is), but rather abstract their compatibility by their association. Therefore, we are not seeking to say what these relationships are, but rather that there is a relationship at a higher level of abstraction that groups them together.
blocks.zh: 因此,拟议的小组界定了被抽象为SC和SI概念的语义关系组合. 我们将把这些群体称为抽象群体,即它们并不从字面上定义所涉及的语义关系(例如,我们不提供什么是超名的明确信息),而是通过它们的关联来抽象地描述它们的兼容性. 因此,我们不是想说出这些关系是什么,而是要说,有一种更高层次的抽象关系,将它们组合在一起。

blocks.en: 3.5 Inference in NLI
blocks.zh: 3.5 NLI的推论

blocks.en:
The LLM generates four different responses for each P-H pair, so a robust unification mechanism is essential. Our approach to consolidating the final responses of LLMs uses different techniques for final decision-making, evaluating the best reasoning process according to the abstract information provided. To achieve this, we use three key strategies: 1. Majority Voting provides a robust and straightforward approach to selecting the most consistent answer. 2. Weighted Majority Voting (WMV) [ 51 ] assigns dynamic weights to each classifier,
optimizing the final decision through ensemble learning. 1. Decision Tree Algorithm (Decision Tree) learns the rules, weighing up the correct lines of reasoning for the final answer.
blocks.zh:
LLM为每对P-H生成4个不同的响应,因此一个强大的统一机制至关重要. 我们合并法学硕士最后反应的方法在最后决策中采用不同的技术,根据所提供的抽象信息评价最佳推理过程。 为此,我们采用三项关键战略: 1. 多数表决为选择最一致的答案提供了一个有力和直截了当的办法。 2. 加权多数表决(WMV)[51]为每个分类者分配动态加权数,
通过综艺学习优化最终决定. 1.决定树算法(决策树)学习规则,权衡最终答案的正确推理线.

blocks.en: Majority Voting provides a robust and straightforward approach to selecting the most consistent answer.
blocks.zh: 多数表决为选择最一致的答案提供了有力和直截了当的办法。

blocks.en:
Weighted Majority Voting (WMV) [ 51 ] assigns dynamic weights to each classifier,
optimizing the final decision through ensemble learning.
blocks.zh:
加权多数投票(WMV) [51] 给每个分类者分配动态加权,
通过综艺学习优化最终决定.

blocks.zh: 决策树算法(决策树)学习规则,权衡最终答案的正确推理线.

blocks.en:
For the latter two algorithms, additional sampling of pairs (P, H) is required for training only. The intuition behind this proposal is that each group ( G 1 ​ – ​ G 4 G_{1}\textendash G_{4} ) provides unique information about the relationships between P and H, resulting in different lines of reasoning. Combining these answers
maximizes the influence of lines of reasoning that lead to correct answers, resulting in a more reliable and informed final decision.

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Abstraction groups influence on LLMs

blocks.en: The proposed abstraction groups were designed to capture semantic compatibility and incompatibility relationships in order to induce a line of reasoning in the LLMs. The hypothesis is that each abstraction group will induce responses with some tendency; for example, a tendency toward entailment or toward contradiction. Thus, the first question is to what extent these semantic abstraction groups influence the reasoning process of each model. For this analysis, LLMs were prompted using the template of Figure 6 for each group.
blocks.zh: 拟议的抽象组旨在捕捉语义兼容性和不兼容关系,以便在LLMs中诱导一条推理线. 假设是,每个抽象组会以某种倾向引起反应;例如,产生或产生矛盾的趋势。 因此,第一个问题是这些语义抽象组在多大程度上影响了每个模型的推理过程. 为进行这一分析,采用图6的模板对每个组进行有限责任管理。

blocks.en: 4.2.2 The GS_DT system performance
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 GS-DT系统业绩

blocks.en: Figure 8 shows that there always seems to be at least one group that performs better than the baseline on average. Thus, the second question is how to reach a consensus on the responses that each abstraction group elicits.
blocks.zh: 图8显示,似乎总至少有一组业绩优于平均基线。 因此,第二个问题是,如何就每个抽象群体所收到的答复达成共识。

blocks.en:
To unify the criteria, we experimented with the strategies proposed in Section 3.5 . This allows us to deal with the variability of the LLMs’ responses, when provided with information about the group, and identify the best strategy to decide on the correct answer. In the case of WMV and DT, it is necessary to choose training and test samples from each dataset.
For majority voting, only the most frequent prediction is taken.
blocks.zh:
为了统一标准,我们试验了第3.5节提出的战略。 这使得我们可以在获得关于该团体的资料时,处理LLMS的反应的可变性,并确定决定正确答案的最佳战略。 就WMV和DT而言,有必要从每个数据集中选择培训和测试样本。
对于多数投票,只作出最频繁的预测。

blocks.en:
After several trials, we decided to use DT as the consensus mechanism, as it consistently obtained the best results.
Henceforth, we will refer to our proposal combining the abstraction groups and the decision tree as GS_DT.
blocks.zh:
经过几次试验后,我们决定利用贸易改革作为协商一致机制,因为它一直取得最佳结果。
今后,我们将将我们合并抽象组和决策树的建议称为GS_DT。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
The implementation of our approach combines prompting techniques with consensus mechanisms.
In line with [ 56 , 57 , 58 , 59 ] methodology, we explore different lines of reasoning for the same question. In our work, we construct abstract groups of semantic relationships that influence the reasoning of LLMs.
blocks.zh:
实施我们的方法将激励技术和共识机制结合起来。
按照[56,57,58,59]方法,我们探讨同一问题的不同推理思路. 在工作中,我们构建了影响LLMs推理的抽象语义关系组.

blocks.en: 5.1 Consensus mechanism
blocks.zh: 5.1 协商一致机制

blocks.en: The choice for the consensus mechanism was made after several trials that consistently showed that DT was the best option. Figure 12 illustrates the point for the SICK dataset.
blocks.zh: 协商一致机制的选择是在几次试验之后作出的,这些试验始终表明,争议法庭是最好的选择。 图12说明了SICK数据集的点.

blocks.en: Figure 12 : Comparison of consensus mechanism performance: VM vs WVM vs DT - dataset SICK
blocks.zh: 图12:共识机制性能比较:VM vs WVM vs DT - 数据集 SICK

blocks.en: Figure 12 shows how a majority voting strategy is not an adequate mechanism for making an informed decision. In a traditional majority voting scheme, the assumption is that when asked the same question, regardless of how the model is prompted, it should arrive at the same answer and be consistent in its reasoning. In other words, the model would have to follow the same line of reasoning regardless of how it is prompted.
blocks.zh: 图12显示多数投票战略如何不是作出知情决定的适当机制。 在传统的多数投票方案中,假设是,当被问及同一问题时,无论该模式是如何引发的,它都应该得出相同的答案,并符合其推理. 换句话说,无论该模式是如何引发的,都必须遵循同样的推理。

blocks.en: What our results show is that, when asked the same question, at least one of the groups provides relevant disjunctive information about the elements of the question (Figure 8 ). Therefore, the models follow different lines of reasoning in each instance. However, what Figure 12 shows is that if the decision is made based on the majority of votes, the result is practically the same or worse than the baseline vote: majority voting fails, in contrast to [ 60 , 61 , 62 ] . The weighted majority voting scheme helps a little. However, it is unable to resolve ambiguous situations, and the weighting pattern is clearly inconsistent across the models.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,在被问及同一问题时,至少有一个小组就问题的内容提供了相关的断开信息(图8)。 因此,模型在每种情况下遵循不同的推理线. 然而,图12显示,如果决定是根据多数表决作出的,结果实际上与基线表决相同或差:多数表决失败,与[60、61、62]形成对照。 加权多数投票办法有一点帮助。 然而,它无法解决模棱两可的情况,各模型的加权模式明显不一致。

blocks.en: What the decision tree does is identify the pattern of agreement between groups that leads to the correct decision. If the abstraction groups were not consistently providing useful information, there would be no pattern to identify. Therefore, abstraction groups fill knowledge gaps in the models, prompting them to take consistent lines of reasoning and give correct answers consistently.
blocks.zh: 决策树所做的是确定导致正确决定的各组之间的协议模式. 如果抽象组不连贯地提供有用的信息,就不会有可识别的模式。 因此,抽象组填补了模型中的知识空白,促使它们采取一致的推理思路,一致给出正确的答案.

blocks.en: A final consideration regarding the relevance of using the decision tree for final decision-making in an LLM regards recent strategies based on debate. A strategy to improve LLMs’ responses is carried out through multi-agent discussion [ 63 ] , based on majority voting. In this sense, our consensus mechanism uses an explicit hierarchical decision tree to avoid the inconsistencies of debate among LLMs, such as error propagation or judge bias [ 63 ] , and to ensure greater control and reliability in responses. Thus, we focus on compensating for the inherent shortcomings of LLMs, regardless of their size: the agent becomes stronger, which could lead to better arguments in scenarios involving debate between agents. This allows us to achieve robust results without incurring the high costs associated with use of industry standard (larger) LLMs.
blocks.zh: 关于在LLM中利用决策树进行最后决策的相关性的最后审议,涉及基于辩论的近期战略。 通过基于多数表决的多代理人讨论,实施了一项改进有限责任公司对策的战略。 从这个意义上讲,我们的协商一致机制使用明确的分级决定树,以避免有限责任公司之间辩论的不一致,例如错误传播或判断偏差[63],并确保在答复中加强控制和可靠性。 因此,我们侧重于补偿有限责任公司固有的缺点,而不论其规模大小:代理人变得更加强大,这可能导致在涉及代理人之间辩论的情况下提出更好的论点。 这使得我们能够在不引起与使用工业标准(较大)有限责任公司有关的高昂费用的情况下取得强有力的成果。

blocks.en: 5.2 Performance
blocks.zh: 5.2 业绩

blocks.en: Simply incorporating direct information from external resources is not enough (Table 5 ); a strategy is also needed to address the shortcomings of LLMs. DT_GS in our framework acts as a meta-reasoner that prioritizes high-confidence routes of reasoning and assigns greater weight to relationship groups where there is strong consensus. Furthermore, it learns trade-offs, e.g., when multiple LLM decisions conflict, the tree learns to combine signals from these decisions about the groups.
blocks.zh: 仅仅纳入来自外部资源的直接信息是不够的(表5);还需要一项战略来克服法学硕士的缺点。 DT_GS在我们的框架中扮演一个元理性者的角色,它优先考虑高度自信的推理路线,并赋予有强烈共识的关系团体更大的份量. 此外,它还学习权衡,例如,当多个LLM决定发生冲突时,树学会结合这些决定中有关各群体的信息.

blocks.en:
The results (Tables 2 and 3 ) show that llama3 models make better use of the new information in their reasoning processes.
With DT_GS, their results range from an improvement of 5.7 to 11.6 p.p. in the SICK , SNLI and SciTail datasets compared to baseline. We were able to outperform the baseline model in these datasets, but for the RTE dataset, even if higher, results are not significant, except for the llama3 models.
blocks.zh:
结果显示(表2和表3),lama3模型在其推理过程中更好地利用了新信息.
通过DT_GS,其结果与基线相比,SICK,SNLI和SciTail数据集的改进幅度从5.7到11.6p. 我们能够超越这些数据集中的基线模型,但对于RTE数据集,即使更高,结果也并不显著,除了lama3模型.

blocks.en: Overall, GS_DT is an effective strategy for improving the performance of language models, particularly those with a lower initial performance. In models that are already optimized, however, the impact is marginal; a conjecture is that this may be due to training data contamination.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,GS_DT是提高语言模型,特别是初级性能较低的语言模型绩效的有效战略. 然而,在已经优化的模型中,影响是微不足道的;一种猜测是,这可能是由于培训数据污染所致。

blocks.en: Also, GS_DT is the most balanced and robust proposal, providing the best overall performance in terms of accuracy and distinguishing cases where there is no entailment relationship (Figures 9 and 10 ).
blocks.zh: 此外,GS_DT是最平衡和最有力的提议,在准确性和区分没有必然关系的情况方面提供了最佳的总体业绩(图9和10)。

blocks.en:
Finally, the SuperGLUE benchmark [ 64 ] provides a diagnostic dataset specifically designed to assess linguistic competence in NLI.
The analysis reveals that not only are there profound variations in the performance of models on the diagnostic dataset, but they also have profound limitations in semantic understanding (Table 5 ).
GS_DT improves and balances the inference in the diagnostic dataset (Table 4 ); thereby better benefiting the not entailment class.
blocks.zh:
最后,SuperGLUE基准[64]提供了一个诊断数据集,专门用来评估NLI的语言能力.
分析显示,模型在诊断数据集上的性能不仅存在深刻差异,而且在语义理解方面也有着深刻的局限性(表5)。
GS_DT改进和平衡了诊断数据集中的推论(表4),从而更好地使不引起影响的类别受益。

blocks.en: 5.3 Impact of abstraction
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 抽象的影响

blocks.en: Current evaluation methods for LLMs primarily assess inferential capabilities through outcome-based metrics. However, this fails to capture the complexity of their underlying reasoning processes. Notably, when faced with straightforward questions that require the application of general knowledge, these models often struggle to abstract and utilize relevant information, exposing a significant shortcoming in their abstract reasoning abilities [ 13 , 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 目前对有限责任措施的评价方法主要通过基于成果的衡量方法评估推论能力。 然而,这未能反映其基本推理过程的复杂性。 值得注意的是,当面临需要应用一般知识的直截了当的问题时,这些模型往往难以抽象地利用相关信息,暴露出其抽象推理能力的重大缺陷[13、19]。

blocks.en: Our approach aims at enriching LLMs with relevant, abstract and structured knowledge to improve their performance in NLI tasks. Abstraction not only improves immediate performance; it redefines how LLMs integrate knowledge and how they use it. In contrast to techniques such as Abstraction-of-Thought (AoT) [ 48 ] , which relies on the model generating its own abstractions (with the risk of inconsistency or hallucinations), our proposal of external abstract categories of semantic relations structures the reasoning space and allow us to trace the decision-making process, something impossible with raw data.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法旨在以相关、抽象和结构化的知识丰富法学硕士课程,以提高它们在国家学习学院任务中的绩效。 抽象不仅改善即时性能,还重新定义了LLMS如何整合知识及其使用. 与像抽象(AoT)[48]这样的依赖模型产生自身抽象(有不一致或幻觉的风险)的技术形成对比的是,我们提出的语义关系的外部抽象类别结构了推理空间,并允许我们追踪决策过程,原始数据是不可能实现的.

blocks.en:
When working with raw relationships, LLMs tend to get stuck in literal associations and fail to capture the semantic depth [ 41 ] .
In contrast, by structuring knowledge into abstract categories that mimic human reasoning, models benefit from new concepts or connections between concepts and avoid using learned lexical patterns; in other words, providing novel relationships could prevent a tendency toward overfitting or shortcuts based on certain clues in the premise or hypothesis.
blocks.zh:
在与原始关系合作时,LLMs往往被困在文字关联中,无法捕捉语义深度[41].
相比之下,通过将知识构建成模仿人类推理的抽象类别,模型从概念之间的新概念或联系中受益,并避免使用学到的词典规律;换句话说,提供新的关系可以防止基于前提或假说中某些线索的过度适应或快捷的倾向.

blocks.en: Similarly, abstractions resolve ambiguities by identifying that two concepts can be related in multiple ways, and even detect contradictions and neutrality with greater precision (Figures 9 and 10 ), areas where LLMs often fail.
blocks.zh: 同样,抽象通过确定两个概念可以多种方式关联,甚至更精确地发现矛盾和中立性(图9和图10),解决模糊性问题,这些地方的有限责任管理常常失败。

blocks.en:
The results (Table 5 ) demonstrate that GS_DT is a robust approach
as it balances between generalization and specificity, minimizing false positives.
The AR approach, on the other hand, is superior in tasks where the accurate identification of entailment is crucial. Both approaches, GS_DT and AR, outperform DR and the Baseline consistently, demonstrating the significant impact of their structural improvements.
The latter approaches are limited by their conceptual rigidity and reduced adaptability, as they are based on static, predefined relationships.
blocks.zh:
结果显示(表5) DT是一个强有力的方法
因为它平衡了一般化和特异性,将假阳性最小化。
另一方面,在准确确定所涉事项至关重要的任务中,评估方法更为优越。 GS_DT和AR这两种方法的业绩均超过DR和基线,表明其结构改进的重大影响。
后一种方法因其概念僵硬性和适应性降低而受到限制,因为它们是基于静态的,预先确定的关系.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en:
NLI tasks require analyzing complex implicit/explicit relationships, demanding both the LLM’s internal knowledge and external commonsense [ 65 ] . Our strategy of abstracting categories to guide LLM decisions, improves contradiction detection and entailment classification.
Crucially, LLMs need structured knowledge and not merely more data to bridge reasoning gaps. Our abstraction framework convert raw text into interpretable patterns, correcting biases and boosting generalization. While LLMs’ pretrained knowledge is insufficient for NLI, external data alone also falls short. Our hybrid approach directs attention to overlooked word relationships, enabling models to synthesize missing information.
The quality of external knowledge is relevant because there are biases of incomplete or culturally biased relationships, which affects the generalization of abstract categories. Similarly, its coverage is limited and may lack well-defined relationships, reducing the effectiveness of the method.
There is also the problem of ambiguity in conceptual boundaries, i.e., some relationships may fit into several categories [ 47 ] .
blocks.zh:
NLI的任务需要分析复杂的隐含/显性关系,要求LLM的内部知识和外部常识[65]. 我们的抽象分类策略指导LLM决定,改善矛盾的发现和必然的分类.
关键是,有限责任公司需要结构化的知识,而不仅仅是更多的数据来弥补推理差距。 我们的抽象框架将原始文本转化为可解释的图案,纠正偏见,促进通俗化。 虽然LLMs的预训知识对于NLI是不够的,但仅外部数据也不足。 我们的混合方法引导人们关注被忽略的文字关系,使模型能够合成缺失的信息.
外部知识的质量之所以相关,是因为存在不完全或文化上有偏见的关系,影响了抽象类的概括. 同样,其覆盖面有限,可能缺乏明确界定的关系,降低了方法的有效性。
还有一个概念界限模糊的问题,即一些关系可能属于若干类别[47]。

blocks.en: The results reveal the benefits of our semantic relation abstraction framework for compensating for knowledge gaps in LLMs. The future lies not in expanding model size [ 66 ] , but in creating a semantic scaffolding that mimics the flexibility of human thinking. We hope that our proposal will enable the development of more robust agents and interpretable reasoning, guiding AI toward a reliable understanding of language.
blocks.zh: 结果揭示了我们语义关系抽象框架对弥补法学硕士课程中的知识差距的益处。 未来不在于扩大模型尺寸[66],而在于创造模仿人类思维灵活性的语义脚手架. 我们希望,我们的建议将有助于发展更强大的代理人和可解释的推理,指导大赦国际可靠地理解语言。
